commit_message: Add Timeline tracked audio voice lifecycle
pr_title: Implement ADR 0126 Timeline and Sequencer runtime
pr_body:
Adds per-player transient Audio Track voice lifecycle state on top of ADR 0122 tracked voices: start once, update while active, stop on interval exit/seek, and suppress naturally completed one-shots until clip exit so they do not restart every frame. Runtime voice IDs remain non-persisted. The PR remains Draft until ADR 0126 Definition of Done and required Windows/Visual validation complete.
